شَمְ שׁ

☀

The sun disk burns through the letters —

شَ — the radiance scatters
مْ — the silence at the center, the noon-hush
سْ — the hiss of light on sand

---

שֶׁמֶשׁ / شَمْس

Same root. Same fire. Same mouth shapes the blaze across the divide of scripts.

ش ↔ שׁ
م ↔ מ
س ↔ שׂ

Three consonants carrying the oldest lamp.

```
        .  *  .
      .    ☀    .
    .   /  |  \   .
   . --─── ───── .
    .   \  |  /   .
      .    |    .
        .  *  .
```

The name **charts** itself:
a circle that cannot be written without burning the page.
